changelog: - **Gates that split and join again no longer lose resource.** When a Gate's branches meet again at a later Gate, with no Converter between them, and the join or anything after it was short of room, each branch used to send as much as the join could take on its own, and the difference disappeared with only a "held" notice in the run bar. Such a group of Gates is now planned as one, as two Gates merging already were: it moves the most the whole group can carry, a second entry gets what the first leaves, and a `pull all` Gate in it that cannot take its full amount stops the whole group for that step. Separately, a planned group no longer moves a billionth more than a Pool can hold or holds, so a capped Pool's amount always equals what its connections report. None of the bundled examples changes.
